title: Metta Sutta 4
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett closes Nomon's line-by-line study of the Metta Sutta with verses nine and ten, reading the Pali alongside the chant-book and Thanissaro Bhikkhu translations. Nomon explains the Brahma Viharas and the sutta's final line about never lying in the womb again, then walks through the four stages from stream-enterer to arhat. The ending is reread as being freed from the duality of birth and death, and Nomon brings in the Buddha's "cultivate the good" and a Dalai Lama passage on warm-heartedness. Questions from the group take up rebirth and Jehovah's Witness ideas of a creator. Nomon ends by asking what class to offer after Friday sitting.
